title: memory-org
description: Use this when you need an agent that organises or retrieves memories scoped to a project or organisation.

title: test-runner
description: Use this when you need an agent that runs test suites and reports results.

title: sox-memory (graph memory subsystem)
description: Use this when you want the full sox-memory graph-memory subsystem installed in one command — expands to memory-daemon (supervised Unix-socket writer daemon), memory-server (7 MCP tools, stdio), memory-flush (SessionEnd hook), and memory-cli (store lifecycle commands).

title: Memory CLI
description: Use this when you need to manage the sox-memory store from the shell — provides memory init|status|list|registry subcommands for store lifecycle, scope selection, and registry inspection. Fully deterministic; zero LLM calls.

title: Memory Daemon
description: Supervised Unix-socket daemon that drains the organizer queue and calls memory-organizer for LLM processing

title: Memory Session Flush
description: Use this when you need session memory durably persisted at conversation end and scope promotions reviewed — binds SessionEnd (persists working memory, enqueues episodes, nudges memoryd) and ScopePromotionProposed (runs promotion approval policy). Deterministic; zero LLM calls.

title: Memory Organizer
description: Use this when memoryd needs to promote raw episodes into structured graph knowledge — runs batched relation extraction, importance scoring (1–10), contradiction detection, and reflection synthesis via LLM. Invoked by memoryd on the write path; never called on the read path.

title: Agent Memory Server
description: Use this when an agent needs durable, searchable memory across sessions — exposes 7 memory_* tools over a single-file SQLite graph store with hybrid recall (vec+BM25+temporal, <50ms, zero LLM), write-enqueue, session state, community lookup, and bi-temporal invalidation.

title: dep-inject
description: Use this when you need a slash command that demonstrates dependency injection patterns.

title: di-codex
description: Use this when you need a skill that demonstrates dependency injection for Codex-based workflows.

title: dep-injector
description: Use this when you need a skill that demonstrates dependency injection for Claude-based workflows.

title: forbidden-access
description: Use this when testing permission enforcement — this skill targets a forbidden host path and must be rejected.

title: sox-ingest — Ingest external sources into sox-ecosystem
description: Use this when you need to port an external repo, file, or directory into sox-ecosystem as born-conformant extensions. Encodes the full ingestion flow: initialize -> generalize+author -> validate -> publish -> install -> enable -> remove-old, delegating per-type and per-operation specifics to references/. An agent told 'ingest <source> into sox' loads this skill and runs the complete flow with no bespoke prompts.

title: Using the sox memory system
description: Use when an agent should recall prior knowledge or store durable findings in the sox graph-memory system via the memory_* MCP tools (memory_recall / memory_write / memory_search_entities / memory_invalidate).

title: sox CLI
description: LLM extension ecosystem CLI — extension #0 (D1/D2 self-hosting)
